label: Killed, eastern DRC since Jan 2025
source: PM Judith Suminwa / DRC government (Feb 24, 2025 statement)
contestNote: UN estimates for the Goma battle alone range from ~787 to nearly 3,000; a comprehensive, independently verified regional total has not been established.

label: Internally displaced persons (nationwide)
deltaNote: IDP count fell from a 2025 peak of ~9.7M total displaced amid ~1.9M returns, 90% in North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri

label: Rubaya coltan mine control
deltaNote: Mine remains under rebel taxation despite Feb 2026 addition to a US strategic minerals shortlist

label: DRC v. Rwanda ICJ case status
deltaNote: Jurisdictional challenge by Rwanda rejected same day the case was filed

label: Washington Accords status
delta: Aug 22 Doha roadmap agreed; first EJVM+ mission due Aug 24 in Minembwe
deltaNote: DRC and M23 agreed a sequenced roadmap and standardized ceasefire-violation reporting after Aug 17-21 Geneva talks, even as fighting continued in Fizi, Minembwe, Kalehe, Masisi and (for the first time since May) Walungu; FDLR disarmament remains the unresolved core DRC-Rwanda obligation

label: Doha comprehensive peace deal target
contestNote: An Aug 22, 2026 roadmap set sequenced negotiation steps, but M23 has made no firm disarmament commitments and fighting widened across Fizi, Minembwe, Kalehe, Masisi and Walungu even as the roadmap was signed

label: People needing humanitarian aid, 2026
deltaNote: Insecurity, gender-based violence and cholera outbreaks compound the crisis
